title: Chapter 514
text:
His name was Keton, and he was the owner of this house. He used to work for the Godora Investigation Bureau. However, he was fired due to his negligence and was imprisoned for many years. After he was released, he moved to the Colonial Planet Gautin and had been living there ever since. The other two were his friends.

"Of course, I've heard about it. The television is always talking about how many low-level civilizations have met with disasters." The other person shook his head.

"It has nothing to do with us. Why are you talking about this? Are you trying to steal a card when I'm not paying attention?"

"Scram." Keton was not in a good mood. He then lowered his voice and said softly, "Do you still remember what I told you?"

"Which one?"

"What happened when I was still working for the Investigation Bureau."

"Heh, you've bragged about it a few hundred times. We're tired of hearing it."

Keton laughed. "Do you know, that planet is also on the list of disasters. I don't know what it has become over the years. I want to go back and take a look. How about it? Do you want to come along?"

"Are you sure? That planet isn't safe now. "

"The older I get, the more I want to see my past achievements." Keton laughed. "Furthermore, my old friend has always been there. He can guide us and guide us. Furthermore, the disaster relief team is there too. We can pretend to be visitors or volunteer to help the disaster relief."

The two of them were surprised when they heard this.

"It can't be. He's still on a primitive planet? Won't he be bored to death? "

"Are you stupid? His cockpit can be connected to the internet. I've always been in contact with him. He …"

Kedan rubbed his hands excitedly. Just as he was about to continue speaking, the doorbell suddenly rang. Ding dong, Ding dong, Ding dong! The three of them jumped in fright.

"It's already so late. Who's looking for me?"

Keton was puzzled. He walked to the door and looked through the peephole. There were a few people he did not recognize outside the door. They were wearing combat uniforms with a circular pattern in the center of their chest. He seemed to have seen this symbol somewhere before.

Opening the small window on the door, Keton revealed his face and asked cautiously, "Who are you looking for?"

The man sized Kieran up and asked, "Are you Golden Midland?"

Strange, how did this group of people know my username? Kedan felt that something was wrong and denied it. Just as he was about to close the window, the person outside the door suddenly raised a laser pistol and aimed it at Kedan's forehead.

Kedan's entire body stiffened, and he did not dare to move. His legs trembled uncontrollably, thinking that the other party was going to rob him. Before he could even beg for mercy, he heard the other party's next sentence, causing a chill to run down his spine.

"Do you remember Angele?"

"I, I don't … I don't know …" Kedan's eyes widened as his lips trembled. At this moment, his panic was completely different from before. It was as if this name carried a terrifying curse.

The person outside the door tilted his head. "It doesn't matter if you don't know him. If you don't want to suffer, come with me."

"Where … where are we going?"

"Black Star wants to see you."

…

Several days later.

The Sky Ring Mercenary Group's spaceship was quietly waiting outside the atmosphere of Blue Star. Han Xiao was piloting the Blacklight Stealth. He saw the other party from afar and approached to dock.

Only Hannes and Bennett were in the cockpit. This was the first time they had taken a spaceship into space. They looked at the scenery outside in a daze. This was the first time they had experienced such a novel experience. From the ground to outer space, it only took a few seconds. Before they could react, they had already flown into space.

Han Xiao told the others to stay on the ground. This trip was just a handover, and there was no need to make a big fuss. Sky Ring's progress was gratifying. They had followed the clues he had given them and found Angele's friend. He seemed to be called Kedan, and they seemed to know Angele's background. They had spent a lot of effort to bring Kedan out.

The spaceship docked, and the hatch opened. A few Sky Ring mercenaries escorted Kedan to meet with Han Xiao's group. After greeting each other, Han Xiao looked at Kedan. At this time, this Godora person had a panicked expression on his face, and his eyes were filled with fear.

"Don't be afraid. I just want you to tell me some information." Han Xiao took out Angele's portrait and said, "You know this person, right?"

Kedan shook his head like a rattle-drum.

The Sky Ring mercenary interrupted, "I gave him a lie detector. He's lying."

"Since you're so scared, you probably know some inside information. Then I'll ask you directly … Are you related to Blue Star's war in the past?" Han Xiao's eyebrows jumped. He might have caught the culprit.

"No! I've never heard of Blue Star before! You've got the wrong person! "Kedan's teeth were chattering. Of course, no one believed him.

Han Xiao took out a fingernail-sized metal plate and placed it on Kedan's neck. He then activated it with his Mechanical Force. Kedan's entire body trembled violently, and his eyes rolled back. He fell to the ground, twitching non-stop, and lost control of his bladder.

"Let me introduce it." Han Xiao pointed at the metal plate and said, "When this little cutie is activated, it will release a high voltage. If you like this feeling, then never open your mouth and slowly enjoy it."

The electrotherapy was a violent interrogation. Kedan's attributes popped up on the interface. He was just an ordinary person, not a Super.

Kedan was like a fish on land. He was electrocuted to the point that he kept jumping around. A few minutes later, he begged for mercy with tears streaming down his face. He promised to tell them everything he knew, just so that he would not be tortured.

Everyone lifted Kedan up and placed him on a chair to let him rest. They also put a lie detector on him. Kedan's hands and feet were still trembling. He looked at Han Xiao with a guilty conscience and began to speak.

"I … I used to be a low-level member of Godora's investigation department. That was a few decades ago. At that time, Godora had just discovered the Blue Star Civilization. A low-level civilization that was still on the surface would normally be observed. My job was to observe the development of this new civilization for a long period of time before making an assessment and submitting it to the War Bureau or the Ministry of Foreign Affairs. This job was very easy, but it was also very boring …"

"Get to the point. What is your relationship with the Blue Star Civilization?" Hannes asked.

Kedan's lips trembled, and he said in a low voice, "That … that was my doing. I used my position to find someone to go to Blue Star Civilization and let him start the war in secret …"

"It is indeed related to Godora!" Hannes was furious. Bennett also stood up with a sullen expression.

"How exactly did you do it?" Han Xiao felt that it was a little strange.

Kedan explained it once. He pretended to be a guest from a high-leveled civilization and contacted some countries privately, making some false promises or emphasizing some theories. In any case, the words of a high-leveled civilization were easily accepted by the indigenous civilizations. Then, he secretly fanned the flames. During this period, he also met some people with bad intentions, but the disguised emissary had an invisible spaceship, so he was not afraid at all.

At that time, Blue Star had just found out about the existence of a high-leveled civilization in the galaxy. It was a time when the world was in chaos. If things continued to develop naturally, there might be a chance for things to stabilize again. Furthermore, the various countries would deepen their cooperation and enter the new era peacefully. This was the most logical thing to do.

However, at such a time, there were aliens secretly fanning the flames and intensifying the conflicts. As long as the flames of war were ignited, it would spread like wildfire. Even countries that did not want to go to war would be dragged into the whirlpool and unable to stay out of it.

In the end, Blue Star broke out into a great war of the old era, and only six countries were left. The theory of internal friction was the source, but more importantly, the 'emissary from a high-leveled civilization' led the development of the civilization to the path of war. Most of the records of the emissary were destroyed.

Hannes had already guessed this before, and now that his guess was confirmed, he was furious. Bennett was the same. They were people who had experienced a great war, and at this moment, they felt a chill down their spines.

The civilization that was helping Blue Star was the mastermind behind the plot against them in the past. Why would a galactic civilization do such a thing? Were they trying to swallow up Blue Star? Or were they trying to get rid of an enemy with potential?

"What about Angelo?" Han Xiao asked with a frown.

"He and I have been friends since we were young. We used to go to school together, but my results were excellent, so I got into a school under the Investigation Bureau. After that, he moved away from his mother planet, and we did not meet for a period of time. However, our relationship is still very good, so I found him to cooperate. He pretended to be an emissary while I stayed at my post to cover for him."

Han Xiao was about to nod, but he suddenly realized that something was wrong. His eyes flashed, and he said in a deep voice, "Why is Angelo the one pretending to be an emissary? He's just an ordinary citizen. "

He found something suspicious. If this was done by Godora, they would have definitely sent professionals. Why would they choose Angelo? Could it be that Angelo had another identity?

…
